profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and identified in SEC filings by CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site describes the Appian Platform, on which customers build AI-powered processes, and lists capabilities for process automation, giving AI reliability and control, and modernizing legacy applications with AI. It says users can build AI-powered apps without code and embed AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Named use cases include accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and contracts, operations, audit and compliance, case management, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, order management, and contract review. The company says onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%. Appian describes itself as having been named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and its site cites an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

Litigation records for the company list 152 cases in Virginia.
